integer.message: Enter a whole number without decimal places or scientific notation.

number.message: Enter a number using digits and an optional decimal point, without commas or scientific notation.

stock_number.message: Use letters and numbers separated by periods, underscores, slashes or hyphens, without spaces.

uacs_object_code.message: Enter a UACS object code in the format 00000000-00.

property_number_prefix.message: Use only letters, numbers, periods, underscores and hyphens for the property number prefix.

date.message: Enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

month.message: Enter a valid month in YYYY-MM format.

datetime.message: Enter a valid date and time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm format.
